growth_signal.value: Revenue is doubling annually and users are tripling across more than 20 EU markets, with a target of scaling to 1 million used cars sold per year.

raised.value: €70M Series C led by Northzone, with existing lead HV Capital and support from Insight Partners, Stripes and Creandum

entry.idea: CarOnSale runs an online auction marketplace where licensed car dealers, OEMs and fleets buy and sell used cars from each other across Europe, replacing slow, informal wholesale trading with a digital auction.
entry.lesson: Digitizing a large, old-fashioned B2B trading process, and owning the logistics that come after the sale, can turn a marketplace into an end-to-end operating system for an industry.
entry.name: CarOnSale

growth.reason: Revenue is doubling every year and users are tripling across more than 20 markets, clear and fast growth.

market.reason: The European used car wholesale trade is a roughly €450 billion market that dealers everywhere in the region need, a very large and essential industry.

tech.reason: It combines AI-based vehicle valuation with digital auctions and logistics integration, solid engineering that competing marketplaces could build over time.

sources.title: Berlin-based CarOnSale raises €70 million to develop their used car platform | EU-Startups
London VC Northzone leads €70M bet on Berlin's CarOnSale to digitise Europe's €450B used car market — TFN

entry.twist: It prices every car using real transaction data instead of book values, and pairs the marketplace with its own transport and payment handling so a deal closes end-to-end on one platform.
entry.who_pays: Professional car dealers, OEMs and fleet operators pay a commission on each vehicle bought or sold through the platform.
entry.why_now: Europe's used car wholesale trade has stayed largely offline and manual, and dealers now want the speed and pricing accuracy of digital auctions as trading volume grows.
